name: James L. Whipps
prior_offices: Natrona County coroner (listed among current officers on the official elected officials page; he was re-elected in 2026)
background: James L. Whipps is the Natrona County coroner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Oil City News reported that at a July 8, 2026, Politics in the Park forum he described the office's work determining cause and manner of death, identifying the deceased, and notifying next of kin, and said the county's elected officers meet at least once a month.
